signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Elite pass rushers are a mix of strength, speed, and tenacity. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their win rate and block shed speed against one-on-one pass blocks.
Defenders with this ability use faster, more dominant pass rush moves while rushing from the edge of the defense.
Defenders with this ability will frequently attempt and win impact blocks against receivers, tight ends, and running backs.
Defenders with this ability have an increased success rate when using conservative or diving tackles.
Players with this ability will recover from the effects of fatigue at an increased rate between plays.
Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move.
Blockers with this ability will dominantly win impact blocks on screen plays
Defenders with this ability will cause increased fatigue penalties when tackling a ballcarrier with a non-conservative tackle.
Defenders with this ability use faster run shed moves for a better chance at shedding blocks against outside zone plays.
